item.title: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
item.description: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.

item.title: Does Europe regret its bet on U.S. defense?
item.description: Europe bet big on American defense technology and they're now paying the price. Years-long backlogs are underway due to production delays and the U.S. own military needs.

item.title: CEO Jensen Huang resigns from chip giant Nvidia
item.description: The chip giant Nvidia announced that CEO Jensen Huang was stepping down following allegations that he'd had extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
item.description: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.
